change: Question 2305 (trial) shows the manual's Figure 1-7, redrawn for phones, instead of the shared climb-and-descent picture. Its METHOD now reads the chart as it is laid out (across, then down); the KEY FACT card is unchanged.

before.explanation:
GIVEN
OAT +10 deg C, pressure altitude 4000 ft (full throttle, flaps up, 75 KIAS, 2500 lb gross weight).

METHOD (SACAA-01 Figure 1-7, Climb Performance)
Step 1: Enter the OUTSIDE AIR TEMPERATURE - degC axis in the lower panel at +10 deg C.
Step 2: Move up to the 4000 ft PRESSURE ALTITUDE diagonal.
Step 3: From that intersection, transfer straight up into the upper panel to meet the rate-of-climb line.
Step 4: From that point, move right to read the RATE OF CLIMB - FPM scale.

ANSWER
540 ft/min

after.explanation:
GIVEN
OAT +10°C, pressure altitude 4000 ft (full throttle, flaps up, 75 KIAS, 2500 lb gross weight).

METHOD (SACAA-01 Figure 1-7, Climb Performance)
Step 1: Enter the OUTSIDE AIR TEMPERATURE - °C scale at +10°C.
Step 2: Move up to the 4000 ft PRESSURE ALTITUDE diagonal.
Step 3: Go straight across to the rate-of-climb line.
Step 4: Drop straight down to the RATE OF CLIMB - FPM scale.

ANSWER
540 ft/min
